WITH last_dates AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS latest
    FROM main.Player_Attributes
    WHERE date < '2013-07-13'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
), snapshots AS (
    SELECT a.player_api_id, a.date, a.overall_rating, a.defensive_work_rate, p.player_name
    FROM last_dates AS d
    JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS a ON a.player_api_id = d.player_api_id AND a.date = d.latest
    LEFT JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS latest_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS players,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE player_name IS NULL) AS missing_names,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AS donovan_rows,
       MAX(date) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AS donovan_date,
       MAX(overall_rating) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AS donovan_rating,
       MAX(defensive_work_rate) FILTER (WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AS donovan_rate,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overall_rating IS NULL AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low','medium','high')) AS missing_ratings
FROM snapshots

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT a.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a
    WHERE date < '2013-07-13'
)
SELECT player_api_id, date, GROUP_CONCAT(id) AS ids, GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(overall_rating, 'NULL')) AS ratings,
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(defensive_work_rate, 'NULL')) AS work_rates
FROM latest
WHERE recency = 1
GROUP BY player_api_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

arguments.sql:
WITH ranked_updates AS (
    SELECT a.player_api_id,
           a.overall_rating,
           a.defensive_work_rate,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.player_api_id
               ORDER BY a.date DESC
           ) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a
    WHERE a.date < '2013-07-13'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
                    THEN u.overall_rating END) AS donovan_rating,
           AVG(u.overall_rating) AS average_rating
    FROM ranked_updates AS u
    JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = u.player_api_id
    WHERE u.recency = 1
      AND u.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * (donovan_rating - average_rating) / NULLIF(average_rating, 0),
           2
       ) AS percentage_higher
FROM ratings
LIMIT 1
